newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani vegoil rates seen slightly up next week.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani vegoil rates seen slightly up next week.

text.p: Pakistani vegetable oil rates are expected to gain marginally in the next trading week in line with international prices, dealers said on Saturday.
"Vegoil prices in international markets can gain on fresh demand of the commodity in December," a dealer at Jaleel Brothers Limited said.
Dealers said vegoil stocks fell to an estimated 95,000 tonnes last week from 107,000 tonnes the week before. RBD palm oil and palm olein stocks fell to 75,000 tonnes compared to 85,000.
Soybean oil and Sunflower oil stocks fell to 19,000 from 21,000 tonnes. The Ghee Corporation of Pakistan's (GCP) palm oil and palm olien stocks fell to 1,000 from 2,000 tonnes.
Dealers said the GCP purchased 6,000 tonnes of palm oil last week at 545.90 dollars per tonne from Pan Century Edible Oils Malaysia.
Bow Explorer is discharging 6,000 tonnes of palm oil at Port Qasim. Wawasan Courage is at the outer anchorage of Karachi Port with around 13,500 tonnes of palm oil.

Rathcrra with around around 7,500 tonnes of RBD palm oil is expected to arrive on November 30, Venino with 3,600 tonnes of tallow on December 7 and Wawasan Murni with 25,000 of palm oil on December 10.
